Bus services: BMTC Bengaluru + KSRTC statewide (4,434 BMTC codes; 151 KSRTC stations)

BMTC lists Bengaluru city-bus route codes. KSRTC lists intercity services by station and timetable, not one statewide fixed route-number list.

KSRTC — Karnataka-wide station timetables

Search a station and open its official timetable for destinations, service classes and departure times.

Station list snapshot: 5 October 2026. It includes Karnataka stations and some out-of-state terminals served by KSRTC. Timetables can change; PDF links need an internet connection. Open the latest official KSRTC station list.

Tariff: Bengaluru RTA notification effective 1 Aug 2025 (₹36 first 2 km, ₹18/km after, night ×1.5, wait free 5 min then ₹10/15 min, luggage free up to 20 kg). Applies within BBMP limits. Estimates only — check the latest notification before relying on it.
